id: title:Gilbert09:classify snowflake client timeout cancellation as retryable

review.posthog_relevance: Adds retryable classification and regression test for Snowflake warehouse connector client-side timeout cancellation errors, potentially recovering transient failures without manual intervention.
review.reason: Adds a retryable error pattern and its rationale, and adds a corresponding unit test.
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on the transient nature of the specific client-side timeout; while the implementation and test are present, the actual recovery and its impact on production stability are not independently verified.
